capabilities: Pick or search a code block language from a 40+ language pill, including custom languages
Copy code block content with a hover button
Create code fences by typing ··· or ···language and pressing Enter
Delete empty code blocks with Backspace and select block content with Ctrl/Cmd+A
Customize code block background, border radius, and padding
disambiguation: Not a syntax highlighter or code executor; it only adds header UI and input conveniences to code blocks.
extras: The README is bilingual (Chinese and English) and states the plugin is coming soon to the community plugin browser, with manual GitHub installation available now. Requires Obsidian v1.4.0+.
intentEvidence: Siyuan-like code blocks with a language pill (click-to-pick dropdown)
problem: Obsidian code blocks show plain fence lines with no language picker, copy button, or block-level editing controls in editing and reading modes.

relations.evidence: Siyuan-like code blocks with a language pill (click-to-pick dropdown)

summary: Code block enhancer that adds a header bar with a searchable language pill, hover copy button, and Siyuan-style input triggers to code blocks.
